metadata.title: The limits of inference: reassessing causality in international assessments

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level ILSA microdata or use achievement scores as outcomes.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not conduct an empirical analysis of ILSA microdata and therefore does not apply sampling weights.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study does not mention any validation strategies or external validation of findings.
design_fields._pdf_matched: 118. Rutkowski et al. (2024). The limits of inference: reassessing causality in international assessments.pdf
design_fields.q4b_note: LLM (gpt-5.4-nano): The article does not estimate predictive or causal effects using ILSA microdata; it reassesses the validity of causal claims made with ILSA data and discusses cross-country heterogeneity and identification assumptions.
